evidence_note: WebFetch returned 'proxy refused the connection' for every page fetch attempted (appshunter.io, appfollow.io, justuseapp.com, apps.apple.com). Only WebSearch result summaries were available. Those summaries paraphrase, so almost no verbatim, dated, per-app complaint quotes could be verified. Complaints below are limited to the strings that appeared in quotation in search output. Everything else is listed under not_found. Reddit was not used.
